title: B1.10 standard-WOFOST call ordering, cadence and threshold evidence

events: WOFOST assimilation() exactly once when the WOFOST crop is emerged
integral(2) resets day aggregates at day start
RootExtraction(2) computes current root uptake/reduction quantities
SoilWater trial/retry loop may reduce dt
SoilWater(3) publishes the accepted timestep state
daily_driver_order.cardinality: one or many accepted soil-water substeps inside the crop day

events: cropdevelopment(3) exactly once for the emerged crop
wofost(3) updates phenology and potential/actual WOFOST trajectories
root extension and root distribution are updated after WOFOST using same-day crop/process results
cropdevelopment(4) checks harvest/end after the day's growth update
standard WOFOST can end when updated DVS reaches DVSEND or when the calendar end condition is met

updates_persistent_candidate_memory: shift atmin7 and insert current TMN
day_start_assimilation_semantics.optional_same_day_soil_coupling: when oxygen physics is active, assimilation also publishes max_resp_factor/q10_root/c_mroot/f_senes used by oxygen-stress/root-uptake physics later in the same day
day_start_assimilation_semantics.transaction_implication: day-start preparation must be trial-local inside the parent crop window; nofd/atmin7 may not become committed merely because later soil substeps need read-only outputs

steps: nutrient demand only on the excluded nutrient route
day_end_standard_WOFOST_order.actual_route_note: potential shadow exists in the legacy call order but is explicitly outside F-WOF25 scope; its omission from a future actual-only structural candidate requires an actual-route oracle rather than hidden allocation of potential state

fixed_delt.finding: legacy WOFOST state updates are written around a fixed one-day DELT

leaf_cohort_creation.finding: lvshft shifts the cohort arrays 'with one day', ages all retained cohorts by FYSDEL*DELT, inserts one new youngest cohort and increments ILV once per call
leaf_cohort_creation.temporal_consequence: two half-day calls are not structurally equivalent to one daily call because they create two cohorts and change cohort ordering/ages

leaf_death_and_age_threshold.finding: leaf death is applied to ordered cohorts and cohorts older than SPAN are removed before the daily shift
leaf_death_and_age_threshold.temporal_consequence: event splitting can alter threshold crossing and which cohort is removed

LAIEXP_threshold.finding: GLAIEXP is recomputed only while LAIEXP<6, but LAIEXP is updated from R%GLAIEXP after every standard update
LAIEXP_threshold.temporal_consequence: legacy saved-rate memory exists after the threshold and arbitrary call splitting is not source-equivalent

phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.semantics: crop lifecycle logic sets fl_start_cropemergence and cropdevelopment(2) initializes WOFOST state before day-start assimilation of the active crop
phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.future_event_splitting: requires an explicit lifecycle event; must not be inferred from an arbitrary solver substep

phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.semantics: if DVS+dvr crosses 1 for the first time, fl_anthesis becomes true and dvr is truncated so the daily update lands exactly on DVS=1
phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.future_event_splitting: crossing logic is discrete and call-order dependent

phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.semantics: completion can be forced at VERNDVS during rate calculation or set after the day's WOFOST update when VERN reaches VERNSAT
phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.future_event_splitting: the ordering means completion after VERN accumulation normally affects the next daily development-rate evaluation

phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.semantics: harvest/end is checked after the day-end growth update and can be triggered by the newly updated DVS reaching DVSEND
phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.future_event_splitting: must preserve event ordering relative to the final day's biomass/root update

phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.semantics: root extension follows WOFOST growth and consumes current-day GRRT plus IPTRA_DAY/IQROT_DAY/IALPWET_DAY as configured
phenology_and_lifecycle_thresholds.future_event_splitting: must not be called once per Richards substep merely because soil water substeps are subdaily

source_bound_saved_rate_exceptions.name: VERNRATE
source_bound_saved_rate_exceptions.reason: not reassigned after FL_VERNALISED is already true, yet VERN=VERN+VERNRATE continues to execute on IDSL=2

source_bound_saved_rate_exceptions.name: GLAIEXP
source_bound_saved_rate_exceptions.reason: not reassigned after LAIEXP>=6, yet LAIEXP=LAIEXP+GLAIEXP*DELT continues to execute

diagnostic_saved_rate_only.name: GLA
diagnostic_saved_rate_only.reason: can remain stale when LAIEXP>=6 but no scoped standard-state feedback after the GLai call was found; treat as diagnostic unless a downstream consumer proves otherwise

rate_lifetime_findings.decision: G03 cannot claim that every legacy saved rate is event-local. Exact B1.10 continuation requires either narrowly scoped carryover memory for the two source-bound exceptions or an explicitly qualified theory/code discrepancy correction.
